dedupe_keys.name: wosis world soil information service soil profile database

description: A global database of standardised soil profile data. The WoSIS documentation says it safeguards shared soil profile data, quality-assesses and standardises them and serves them for digital soil mapping and environmental applications, and that some 228,000 geo-referenced standardised profiles, more than 6 million soil records, are served through a WFS, with periodic snapshots such as the WoSIS snapshot 2023 described in Earth System Science Data (2024). Data are free to download and view, supplied under the licence set by each data provider. Coverage is global, with uneven density. Caveats: measured properties vary between profiles and depths, with fewer physical than chemical data, as the page notes. For simulation it gives soil properties at points for geotechnical and agricultural models, such as crop water stress or foundation conditions. A related catalogue record is the ISRIC SoilGrids maps.
